correctness.rationale: Per-leaf three-hub connectivity inclusion-exclusion gives the exact polynomial, corroborated by independent exhaustive enumeration of 37,440 edge subsets for \(2\le n\le5\). Strict power convexity for \(B\ge0\), and odd/even arguments and a positive quadratic for \(B<0\), give \(F_n(q)>0\) for every real \(q\ne1\). Explicit derivatives \(F_n(1)=F_n'(1)=0\) and \(F_n''(1)=6n^2 3^{n-2}>0\) establish a double zero. The exact positive leading coefficient then gives precisely \(2n-2\) remaining nonreal roots. Every integer \(n\ge2\) is covered by the algebraic proof, not the finite checks.
